question: Which licensed stablecoins outside the U.S. are actually live, and is their backing proven?
answer: The library tracks 13 stablecoin products outside the U.S. 6 are live under a local license, and 4 of those publish regular attestations of their reserves (USDG · Singapore; XSGD · Singapore; XUSD · Singapore; Zand AED / AEDZ · United Arab Emirates). The rest are in beta, announced, used without a local license, or have no dated public proof of backing yet; the backing of 1 failed.

items.label: Used locally, licensed elsewhere or not at all

items.title: USDG · Singapore
kv: Segregated cash and cash-equivalent reserves; monthly reports and independent attestations, KPMG from February 2026
Named Singapore issuer; described as substantively compliant with the upcoming SCS framework
MAS Major Payment Institution; Digital Payment Token Service
Live since November 2024 on public blockchain with a mint and redeem path
Public-chain supply observable; regulator-owned Singapore customer or transaction series not located
Direct 1:1 USD purchase and redemption under Paxos terms
Contractual suspension, custody and cross-jurisdiction risks; no Singapore failure case located
An MPI licence and a live product do not create the still-future protected MAS-regulated-stablecoin label.

items.title: XSGD · Singapore
kv: Terms require at least 100% segregated trust-account reserves; actor publishes attestations
Named issuer and live DPT; issuer claims substantive alignment with upcoming framework
MAS Major Payment Institution; exact activities remain legal-person specific
Live on supported networks and through StraitsX distribution arrangements
Public supply and actor claims exist; no MAS-owned national transaction series located
Direct holder redemption subject to onboarding and channel minimums; terms target five business days
Security-incident suspension and unsupported or bridged-token loss terms apply
The legal-person licence and actor disclosures are not a current dedicated SCS product approval.

items.title: XUSD · Singapore
kv: Terms require at least 100% segregated trust-account reserves; actor publishes attestations
Named issuer and live DPT; no current dedicated SCS label
MAS Major Payment Institution; exact activities remain legal-person specific
Live on supported networks and through StraitsX distribution arrangements
Public supply and actor claims exist; no MAS-owned national transaction series located
Direct holder redemption subject to onboarding and channel minimums; terms target five business days
Security-incident suspension and unsupported or bridged-token loss terms apply
The legal-person licence and actor disclosures are not a current dedicated SCS product approval.

items.title: AE Coin / AEC · United Arab Emirates
kv: CBUAE same-currency reserve rule applies; issuer-specific dated attestation not located
Issuer presents a live product and mint/redemption process
No administrative circulation or recurring transaction series located
Issuer and rulebook describe par mint/redemption; performance series not located
No product-specific failure or recovery case located
Licence and product pages do not establish current reserve balances, recurring use or redemption performance.

items.title: Zand AED / AEDZ · United Arab Emirates
kv: Segregated 1:1 reserves; monthly Crowe reports visible February through August 2026
Live on public blockchains since November 2025
Actor and public-chain evidence; no CBUAE administrative volume series located
1:1 terms; observed aggregate redemption performance not located
Risk disclosure says no deposit insurance and preserves liquidity and execution risks
A recurring attestation series does not prove national transaction scale or redemption under stress.

items.title: DDSC · United Arab Emirates
kv: CBUAE reserve rule applies; issuer-specific dated public attestation not located
Approved to go live on ADI Chain; later platform NOC is not proof of listing
One AED 110 million transaction disclosed on 21 May 2026; recurring series not located
Regulatory par-redemption duty; observed redemption record not located
No product-specific failure or recovery record located
One large transaction proves bounded operation, not recurring adoption, public access or current reserves.

items.title: HKDAP · Hong Kong
kv: Statutory and whitepaper 100% reserve/trust design; dated public attestation not located
Non-retail beta access live; issuer says official/full launch has not occurred
Contract and beta access disclosed; administrative circulation or redemption series not located
1:1 at-par design; observed successful-redemption series not located
Issuer warns of fake HKDAP tokens; no licensed-product failure located
A licence and live restricted beta do not establish full public launch, circulation, reserve balances or redemption performance.

items.title: Planned HKD stablecoin · Hong Kong
items.sub: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited
kv: HSBC states full high-quality liquid backing in segregated accounts; dated product attestation not located
Licensed issuer; product remained subject to relevant approvals
Planned for the second half of 2026 through PayMe and HSBC HK App; cutoff launch proof not located
No issuance, circulation or transaction series located
Statutory framework applies; product performance not observable before launch
The issuer licence and launch announcement do not establish a live token balance or customer transaction.

groups.label: Used locally, licensed elsewhere or not at all

items.title: USDC service relationship · Singapore

badge.text: Licensed service firm, not the issuer

kv: Global reserve and attestation record belongs to the applicable issuer arrangement
Singapore customer-service entity; Circle product terms identify issuers separately
MAS Major Payment Institution; payment and DPT services
USDC service live; the Singapore entity is not thereby the token obligor
Circle global supply is not a Singapore-issued or Singapore-used administrative series
Rights depend on Circle terms, eligibility and contracting entity
No Singapore issuer-failure record follows from the service licence
A licensed distributor or service counterparty must not be recast as the issuer of every token it handles.

items.title: USDT · Brazil
items.sub: Tether-related issuer not established by reviewed Brazilian authority
kv: Proof sits with the foreign issuer
Provider must review and disclose issuer, reserve, custodian and audits; product proof remains external
Identified in Receita reporting data, not approved as a product by that report
Brazilian provider-level BCB authorization, transition and due-diligence duties
88.7% of declared stablecoin value from August 2019 through December 2025
Provider must disclose the claim route; direct issuer performance is not established by tax aggregates
No joined Brazilian issuer failure and recovery record located
High declared use does not establish a BCB-approved domestic issuer, reserve sufficiency or par redemption.

studies.title: Stablecoins showed a parallel price, not an escape route

items.title: USDC · Brazil
items.sub: Applicable Circle issuer not established by reviewed Brazilian authority
kv: Proof sits with the foreign issuer
Provider due-diligence rule applies; issuer proof must be joined separately
Identified in Receita reporting data, not approved as a product by that report
Brazilian provider-level BCB authorization, transition and due-diligence duties
7.1% of declared stablecoin value from August 2019 through December 2025
Aggregate reporting does not prove direct redemption access or performance
No joined Brazilian issuer failure and recovery record located
A product name in tax data is not domestic issuer authorization or a verified customer claim path.

items.title: BRZ · Brazil
items.sub: BRZ issuer legal person not established by reviewed Brazilian authority bundle
kv: Reserve and audit proof not supplied
Provider due-diligence rule applies; reserve, custodian and audit proof not supplied by tax data
Identified in Receita reporting data, not approved as a product by that report
Brazilian provider-level BCB authorization, transition and due-diligence duties
3.4% of declared stablecoin value from August 2019 through December 2025
Aggregate reporting does not prove direct redemption or par under stress
No joined official failure and recovery record located
Local-currency reference and reported use do not identify the exact obligor or establish authorization.

items.title: Stablecoin name withheld · Switzerland
kv: Two-guarantee structure described; one guarantee ceased; reserve composition and attestation withheld
Arrangement became unlawful acceptance of public deposits after full repayment was no longer assured
Functional perimeter; one of two bank default guarantees later fell away
Product operated before enforcement; exact launch and network withheld
Balances, supply, users and transactions withheld
At-any-time repayment was no longer fully assured; actual redemptions and customer outcome withheld
Final FINMA decision 16 December 2025 ordered restoration and cessation; liquidation threatened for noncompliance
The case proves a guarantee-dependent structure can fail, not the token identity, customer loss or recovery distribution.

uncertain: An attestation is an accountant's report on reserves at one moment; it is not a full audit.
U.S. coins, including Open USD, are on the stablecoin issuers page.
Coverage state describes the state of this research, not a jurisdiction's crypto friendliness, adoption, legality or economic importance.

research.title: Crypto around the world: many licenses, no proven cross-border use
research.answer: Across 22 jurisdictions, we found no verified cross-border payment route that depends on crypto from end to end. The token layer still settles through ordinary banks and national payment systems.
